references.text: The continuation of the account of the boils that struck Egypt, where Moses and Aaron cast soot into the air, causing the disease of boils.
Egyptian boils are mentioned as one of the curses that will strike Israel for disobedience, a direct reference to the plagues in Egypt.
Malignant boils on the knees and thighs are mentioned as punishment, similar to the sixth plague in Egypt.
Job was struck with malignant boils from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head, similar to the plagues that struck the Egyptians.
The first bowl in Revelation causes malignant and painful boils on people, reflecting the sixth plague in Egypt.
